name: flow_duel_mode_button_and_the_caretaker_rival
description: Undertow on the hub, offline (M7, design 1.4, 1.5, 5.2; contract-m7 §4): a duel is the two-team mode of one seat a side (Session.is_duel), so the match a party of one duels (Session.offline_match, what Duel the caretaker plays) is my seat on team 0 against a caretaker of my own Builder on team 1, named 'Caretaker 1', and a caretaker partner asked for has no seat in it, as a race team holds two and High Water four. This build has the duel's rules (Profile.offers('undertow')), so the mode button is lit and says what the mode is; the mode line says 1v1, not '2–2 players'. A party of one in Undertow offline gets Duel the caretaker, and pressing it plays the duel on Undertow's own preset: both seats on the board, the rival played by the caretaker from tick 0.

steps.assert: Session.is_duel('undertow') and not Session.is_duel('tide_race') and not Session.is_duel('high_water') and Session.team_seats('undertow') == 1 and Session.team_seats('tide_race') == 2
steps.msg: Undertow is the duel: two teams of one seat

steps.assert: Session.caretaker_word('undertow') == 'Duel the caretaker' and Session.caretaker_word('tide_race') == 'Race the caretaker'
steps.msg: a party of one duels the caretaker, or races it

steps.assert: duel.size() == 2 and duel[0]['team'] == 0 and duel[0]['builder'] == 'lookout' and not duel[0].get('caretaker', false)

steps.msg: the rival: a caretaker of my own Builder on team 1
a duel has no seat for a partner: one a side

steps.assert: spec['shown_mode'] == 'undertow' and spec['offline'] and not spec['try'] and spec['seats'] == duel
steps.msg: the match Duel the caretaker plays: the duel's two seats
the rival chose my Builder and is named as a caretaker
partners only as many as a team's seats hold: a race team two, High Water four
this build has the duel's rules: the mode is lit

steps.assert: node('Mode_undertow').tooltip_text == "One against one: cork packs from the Drift and uncork them on your rival's road"
steps.msg: its tooltip says what the duel is
the mode line: one against one

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').primary_text() == 'Duel the caretaker' and not node('Primary').disabled
steps.msg: offline, a party of one in Undertow: Duel the caretaker
Duel the caretaker plays the duel: me against a caretaker Lamplighter from tick 0
